u0: Initial state: the agent has not yet seen the matching key. It must explore the central corridor and side rooms, looking into the left-column rooms to spot the key (key_found) without opening the locked door. Any opening of the locked door, entering the target room, or picking up the target ball is a failure.
u1: The agent has seen the matching key (key_found latched) but is not yet carrying it. Next objective: approach the key and pick it up, obtaining the matching key (has_matching_key), while still avoiding the locked door; opening it, entering the target room, or picking up the ball fails.
u2: The agent holds the matching key but has not yet opened the locked target door. Next objective: navigate to the locked door, toggle it open (target_door_open) to proceed; entering the target room or picking up the ball now would fail because the door is not yet open in this state.
u3: The agent has opened the locked door (target_door_open) and is not yet inside the target room. Next objective: step through the doorway into the target room (target_room_entered); picking up the ball before entering the room fails.
u4: Success state: the agent has entered the target room after opening the locked door. The mission continues while the agent remains in this state; picking up the target ball yields the final reward, and the episode ends.
uf: Failure state: the agent opened the locked door without authorization, entered the target room too early, or picked up the target ball prematurely. The episode is penalized and this state is absorbing.
